content:
End of June was the target to have the Preventive Maintenance Push closed out. That came and went yesterday and it is still sitting open.

Brooke started this in early May, HVAC, plumbing and electrical across the whole portfolio, and I have been the QC eye on it. I logged both cluster spot-checks as passing in late May and my read is that my part of it is finished. The crew called the HVAC run wrapped around the same time.

Before I put my name to this closing out, I need to know where every piece of it stands as of today, cluster by cluster, and I need our records saying the same thing. Work out what is actually finished and what is not, and get our tracking to match. Anything still open gets its own tracking item raised, with the person who owns that work named on it. My own spot-check records are part of that, with a short note left on each one saying where it landed and why.

Anything flagged in the field that still needs a tech back onsite belongs in our maintenance ticket log rather than sitting as a tracking item, and put a slot on my calendar to go back out and re-inspect whatever ends up in that follow-up.

Then post where this stands in the channel the push has been running in so the crew is working off the same picture, and draft an email to Brooke, cluster by cluster, with what is open, who is holding it, and what has to happen before this can close.

I do not want Brooke's email written so it can be read either way. If my QC side is a pass, say pass. If it is not, say straight out that my earlier sign-off does not hold and this should not be treated as closeable yet, with the reasons.
I will search
Slack channels, Linear projects/issues, and Airtable bases to gather all information about the Preventive Maintenance Push, its clusters
, spot-checks, and current status.

parameters.description: Search PDF files using pdftotext for maintenance and QC keywords
parameters.command:
python3 -c "
import os, glob
import subprocess

for f in sorted(glob.glob('/workspace/company_files/reports/*.pdf')):
    res = subprocess.run(['pdftotext', f, '-'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    text = res.stdout
    if any(k in text.lower() for k in ['preventive', 'cluster', 'spot-check', 'spot check', 'hvac', 'plumbing', 'electrical', 'salinas', 'qc']):
        print(f'=== {f} ===')
        print(text[:600])
        print('\n')
"

import json

records = raw['records']

*Preventive Maintenance Push — Portfolio Audit & Status Update (July 1, 2026)*

Team, I've completed a full review of our records and field findings for the Preventive Maintenance Push across all four property clusters. Below is where every piece stands as of today.

*QC Verdict & Close-Out Status:*
The initiative is **NOT CLOSEABLE YET**. While the May HVAC spot-checks cleared, my earlier sign-off does NOT hold for the overall push because open field items and uncompleted cluster scope remain in progress.

---

### *Cluster-by-Cluster Breakdown*

*1. North Cluster — STATUS: COMPLETE (PASSED QC)*
* **HVAC / Electrical / PM Inspections:** All coil servicing, filter swaps, and panel/unit inspections finished and passed QC. (OPS-40, OPS-44, OPS-87, OPS-98 closed).

*2. East Cluster — STATUS: COMPLETE (PASSED QC)*
* **HVAC:** Coil cleaning and filter checks completed by Elias Navarro and verified via QC spot-check. (OPS-99, OPS-108 closed).

*3. South Cluster — STATUS: IN PROGRESS / OPEN ITEMS*
* **HVAC & Electrical:** Coil servicing (Elias) and electrical panel inspections (Patricia) completed and passed QC (OPS-43, OPS-186 closed).
* **Plumbing (OPEN):** Field inspections flagged items requiring tech work onsite.
  * **2 Water Heater Replacements** (past serviceable life) — Logged in maintenance ticket log as *MT-2026-1327*, tracked in Linear as *OPS-1000* | **Owner: Carlos Mendez**.
  * **Hose Bib Repairs** — Logged in maintenance ticket log as *MT-2026-1328*, tracked in Linear as *OPS-1000* | **Owner: Carlos Mendez**.
  * **QC Action:** I have scheduled a re-inspection slot on my calendar for **Monday, July 6 (9:00–11:00 AM)** following tech execution.

*4. West Cluster — STATUS: IN PROGRESS / OPEN SCOPE*
* **HVAC:** Condenser cleaning and filter replacements completed (OPS-91 closed).
* **Remaining PM Scope (OPEN):** Plumbing, electrical, and overall property PM scope remain in progress. Tracked in Linear as *OPS-1001* | **Owner: Lisa Smith**.

---

### *Required Actions Before Close-Out:*
1. **Carlos Mendez:** Coordinate and execute water heater replacements (MT-2026-1327) and hose bib repairs (MT-2026-1328).
2. **Lisa Smith:** Wrap up remaining West Cluster plumbing, electrical, and field PM scope (OPS-1001).
3. **Jaime Salinas:** Perform QC re-inspection on July 6 for South Cluster plumbing repairs and conduct final QC verification on West Cluster upon completion.

Let's get these remaining items buttoned up so we can officially sign off and close out the push.

----------------------------------------------------------------------
